decisions.statement: A predicate reads one sentence rather than a whole text.
A predicate answers with every place the shape is found in that sentence.
A predicate finding nothing answers with an empty list.
A match names the tokens the match is made of.
A token is named by the number the parser gave that token.
A word class every predicate reads is named here rather than in each predicate.
A predicate says nothing about whether akasha writes in the shape.
Whether akasha writes in a shape is the shape page's own answer.

definition: what every sentence shape's predicate over a dependency tree is written against
